latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of happyhorse-video-gen-edit: video generation and editing with HappyHorse models.

- Supports text-to-video, first-frame image-to-video, multi-image reference-to-video (character fusion), and video editing.
- Provides command-line interfaces for all generation and editing tasks.
- Allows configurable options for resolution (720P/1080P), aspect ratio, duration, and watermark control.
- Reference-to-video supports up to 9 images for character fusion in prompts.
- Video editing enables style transfer, background replacement, and reference-based modifications with flexible audio handling.
- Includes clear differentiation from related models (Wan 2.7) in watermarking, prompt support, and reference image handling.
